free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the high-risk imaging finding of a PI-RADS 5 lesion in the left peripheral zone and a concerning PSA velocity of 0.84 ng/mL/yr. This is strongly supported by the csPCa probability of 0.82135016 and the rising PSA trend from 5.7 to 7.6 ng/mL. The decision is made despite the DRE finding of a nodus, as the high-risk imaging and PSA kinetics outweigh this finding.
